description: This file contains the data access layer for the Category model in an expense tracking application. It provides methods for CRUD operations and listing categories owned by a specific user with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: A repository class managing database operations for user-owned categories, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and listing with optional search and pagination.

methods.name: None __init__(self, session: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a database session.

methods.name: Optional[Category] get_owned(self, user_id: int, category_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by ID that is owned by a specific user.

methods.name: Category create(self, user_id: int, name: str)
methods.description: Creates a new category for a user, enforcing unique category names per user.

methods.name: Category update(self, category: Category, name: str)
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing category, ensuring name uniqueness per user.

methods.name: None delete(self, category: Category)
methods.description: Deletes a specified category from the database.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Category],int] list_owned(self, user_id: int, limit: int, offset: int, q: Optional[str])
methods.description: Lists categories owned by a user with support for search filtering, pagination, and total count.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    def create(self, user_id: int, name: str) -> Category:$/

ctags.name: get_owned
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_owned(self, user_id: int, category_id: int) -> Optional[Category]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def list_owned(self, user_id: int, limit: int, offset: int, q: Optional[str]) -> Tuple[List[/
ctags.signature: (self, user_id: int, limit: int, offset: int, q: Optional[str])

ctags.pattern: /^    def update(self, category: Category, name: str) -> Category:$/
